class.name: NNHTNPlanStep
class.brief_description: Represents one planned instance of an [NNHTNTask] in an HTN plan.
class.description: Created by [NNHTNRoot] during planning and passed to [method NNHTNTask.on_execute], [method NNHTNTask.on_verify], and [method NNHTNTask.on_cancel]. Holds the step's resolved [member args], predicted [member effects], lifecycle [member state], and a mutable [member runtime] dictionary for storing per-step progress when the same task template is reused multiple times.

method.name: get_observed_effect_keys
method.description: Returns the effect keys that will not be written automatically on success because of [member NNHTNTask.runtime_effect_commit_mode].

method.name: get_provenance
method.description: Returns the chain of compound/method decompositions that produced this step, used for diagnostics and local repair.

method.name: has_valid_references
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member task] is still valid and enabled and all [Object] values in [member args] are still alive.

members.member: Read-only dictionary of arguments resolved for this step when it was planned.
Slash-separated decomposition path from the domain to this step's task.
Estimated cost captured during [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST] planning, or [code]0.0[/code] under other policies.
Read-only group effects carried by the final step of a serialized [NNHTNParallelTask]. Empty for other steps.
Read-only dictionary of blackboard effects predicted for this step.

Reason code if the step failed (such as [code]"invalidated"[/code], [code]"execution_failed"[/code], [code]"verification_failed"[/code], [code]"verification_timeout"[/code], [code]"verification_unsafe"[/code], or [code]"effect_commit_failed"[/code]), or empty.
Unique positive ID identifying this planned step instance.
Number of branches in this step's [NNHTNParallelTask], or [code]0[/code] if not part of a parallel group.
Zero-based index of this branch within its [NNHTNParallelTask], or [code]-1[/code] if not part of one.
The [NNHTNParallelTask] this step belongs to, or [code]null[/code].
Read-only arguments captured for this step's concurrent [NNHTNParallelTask].
Read-only group effects committed when all branches of a concurrent [NNHTNParallelTask] succeed.
Positive ID shared by branches of the same concurrent parallel group, or [code]0[/code] for sequential steps.
Mutable dictionary for storing per-step runtime progress (such as timers or state) without mutating the shared [NNHTNTask] node.
Current execution state of this step. See [enum State].
The [NNHTNTask] template this step executes, or [code]null[/code] if freed.
Seconds elapsed while waiting in [constant VERIFYING].

constants.constant: Finished executing and waiting for [method NNHTNTask.on_verify] / postconditions to pass.
Parallel branch that finished and is waiting for its siblings before effects commit.
Abandoned before finishing (for example, replaced by a new plan or disabled).
